description: This PHP class defines the 'Country' entity for the OrangeHRM system, mapping to the 'hs_hr_country' database table. It includes properties like country code, name, ISO3 code, and numeric code, along with their getter and setter methods.

classes.name: Country
classes.description: Entity class representing a country with properties for country code, name, ISO3 code, and numeric code, mapped to the database.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the country.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the country.

methods.name: getIso3
methods.description: Returns the ISO3 country code, if set.

methods.name: getNumCode
methods.description: Returns the numeric country code, if set.
